Super excited about this game. I was looking at the SPECIAL descriptions (both what has been announced for fo4 as well as assumptions based on what has been true in fo3 and new vegas). I've put together a couple relationships I've noticed where some SPECIAL abilities are redundant while others are complimentary.

Also note that the transitive property does not apply here. ie: If (A and B) , and (B and C,) than (A and C) does not apply.

For Reference:

  • (only officially announced) http://vault111.com/character/
  • (speculation based on fallout 3 and new vegas) http://orcz.com/Fallout_4:_Perk_Chart

Compliments

  • Strength And Agility - Agility for stealth and strength for melee
  • Strength and Endurance - Tank / melee based builds tend to take more damage
  • Endurance and Intelligence - perks INT lvl 8 (chemist) + END lvl4 (chem resistant) seem like they'd work well together.
  • Intelligence and Perception - For those using guns often. Perception impacts accuracy (in and out of VATS) and intelligence allows for gun modification
  • Agility and Perception - in VATS perception affects accuracy, ability affects amount of VATS points
  • Endurance and Luck - Marine Boy + Fortune Finder seem like they'd work well together.

Contradicts / Overlap - Areas that either don't work well together or try to accomplish the same thing (and your points can be better spent elsewhere).

  • Strength and Charisma - (overlap) Strength affects how much you can carry, Charisma affects your companion effectiveness (including how much they can carry).
  • Strength and Perception - (contradict) Perception affects gun stats while strength is more for melee builds.
  • Strength and Intelligence - (contradict) Same as for STR and PER. Intelligence seems to be mostly about gun modification, not needed for mostly melee builds.
  • Luck and Charisma - (overlap) Luck lets you get better loot, charisma lets you get better deals to buy better products
  • Agility and Endurance - (overlap) Agility lets you avoid damage, while endurance lets you take it and keep going
  • Agility and Charisma - (contradict) Agility affects sneak, and charisma affects companions. If you're going to sneak don't use companions (they will fuck it up for you)

I'm sure there are others that I haven't noticed. If anyone has other ideas it'd be great to hear :)
